output.content:
The **Leads** tab is the master list of every person in your campaign. Use it to see who's been contacted, who hasn't, edit individual records, add more leads, or export the list.

## What's on the tab

Top to bottom:

1. **Status cards** - appear above the metrics when something's running in the background or your last upload skipped some rows.
2. **Metrics row** - six cards showing how the campaign is progressing.
3. **Toolbar** - view toggle, status filter, advanced filter, action buttons (Add Leads / Import Leads / Export Leads / Delete All), and a search box.
4. **The leads table** - one row per lead.
5. **Pagination** - rows-per-page selector and page navigation at the bottom.

## Status cards

These appear above the metrics row when something needs your attention. If you don't see one, nothing's running.

| Card | When it appears |
|---|---|
| **Scrape in progress** | A lead scrape is running on this campaign. Auto-refreshes as new leads land. |
| **Leads skipped during upload** | Your last import or scrape skipped some rows. Shows the reasons and counts (see below). |
| **Scrape failed** | The last scrape errored. Shows the error message so you know what to retry. |

### Why leads get skipped

When a scrape or import skips rows, the warning card spells out the reason. The five categories:

| Reason | What it means |
|---|---|
| **N already in other campaigns** | Cross-campaign duplicate - the lead is already in another campaign in this workspace. |
| **N duplicates** | Within the file itself - the same email appeared twice in the upload. |
| **N in blocklist** | The address is on the workspace [DNC](^ "dnc") list. |
| **N invalid emails** | The address didn't pass format/validation checks. |
| **N incomplete** | Required fields (name, email, industry, company) were missing on those rows. |

## Metrics row - six cards

Six numbers across the top, summarising the campaign:

| Card | What it counts |
|---|---|
| **Leads Uploaded** | The number of leads accepted into the campaign by the connected outreach provider when a provider upload receipt is available. Leads skipped for any reason—including duplicates, do-not-contact rules, invalid emails, incomplete fields, or email-security protections—are not included. Legacy campaigns without a provider receipt may show locally recorded leads. |
| **Leads Contacted** | Unique leads that have received at least one email in the sequence. Compare against Leads Uploaded to see how much of the list has been reached. |
| **Leads In Progress** | Leads who haven't yet completed the whole sequence (still receiving follow-ups). When this hits 0, the campaign moves to **Completed**. |
| **Leads Completed** | Leads who've received every email in the sequence without replying. They won't get any more emails. |
| **Bounced Emails** | Total emails that failed to deliver - invalid addresses, full inboxes, temporary issues. |
| **Email Bounce Rate** | Bounced emails as a percentage of sent emails. Target shown next to it: **under 2% is healthy**. |

## All leads - the default table view

One row per lead. The columns are:

| Column | What it shows |
|---|---|
| **Name** | First and last name combined |
| **Email** | Email address |
| **Company** | Company name |
| **Title** | Job title |
| **Industry** | Lead's industry |
| **Location** | City / state / country, combined |
| **LinkedIn** | LinkedIn URL (if you have one) |
| **Website** | Company website |
| **Company Description** | Short description from the lead source |
| **Status** | Where the lead is in the [lifecycle](^ "lead-lifecycle"). The status pill shows the latest status, with status history available where multiple statuses apply. |
| **Date Added** | When the lead was added to this campaign |

Any **custom variables** you mapped during a CSV upload show as extra columns to the right of these.

A row's three-dot menu has one action: **Edit Lead** - opens a form to update name, company, title, industry, LinkedIn, website, company description, or location. Changes affect future sends only.

### Search, status filter, advanced filter, and sort

Use these controls above the table:

| Control | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Search leads…** (top-right) | Free-text search across the whole table - name, email, company, title, etc. Matches as you type. The fastest way to find a specific person. |
| **Status** | Quick filter for lead status, such as `Not Yet Contacted`, `Contacted`, `Contacted, No Reply`, `Reply Received`, `Interested`, `Meeting Booked`, `Bounced`, and `Unsubscribed`. |
| **Filter** (top-left, funnel icon) | Opens a structured filter builder. Add one or more conditions across these fields: Name, Email, Company, Title, Location, LinkedIn URL, Website, Company Description, Email Sent (Contacted / Not Yet Contacted), Email Provider, Email Security Gateway, and Date Added. Conditions stack - each one narrows the table further. |
| **Column headers** | Click any column header to sort by that column. Click again to reverse the sort. |

The **Status → Not Yet Contacted** filter is the fastest way to see who has not been emailed yet. Use it before exporting a "remaining leads" CSV.

Use **Status → Contacted, No Reply** when you want leads that have been contacted but have not replied.

### Status filter options

Used in the Status filter and in the Status column on each row:

`Not Yet Contacted`, `Contacted`, `Contacted, No Reply`, `Reply Received`, `Interested`, `Not Interested`, `Out of Office`, `Meeting Booked`, `Completed`, `Completed No Reply`, `Bounced`, `Unsubscribed`.

See [Lead lifecycle](/docs/cold-email-agent/concepts/lead-lifecycle) for what triggers each transition.

## History view - per-upload breakdown

Toggle from **All** (list icon) to **History** (clock icon) at the top of the table. The History view groups leads by where they came from - each upload or scrape becomes its own collapsible source group.

For each source group you see:

| Stat | What it counts |
|---|---|
| **Requested** | How many leads you asked for |
| **Received** | How many came back from the lead provider |
| **Verified** | How many passed verification |
| **Uploaded** | How many actually landed in the campaign |

Useful when you've done several uploads - a CSV, a scrape, another scrape - and want to see how each one performed compared to the others.

## Selecting Leads

The checkbox in the table header opens a small selection menu:

| Option | What it selects |
| --- | --- |
| **Select all** | Selects every lead matching your current search, filters, status filter, and sort across all pages. |
| **Select this page** | Selects only the leads visible on the current page. |

When leads are selected, a bulk-action bar appears. It shows either the selected count or **All N selected** when you selected across the whole filtered result set.

Use this bar to:

- Export the selected leads.
- Delete selected leads.
- Clear the selection.

<Callout title="Select all respects your filters" type="info">
If you filter to **Bounced** and choose **Select all**, the bulk actions apply to all bounced leads that match the filter, not the entire campaign.
</Callout>

## Toolbar - Add, Import, Export, Delete

Four buttons sit in the toolbar:

| Button | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Add Leads** | Opens a side panel with two tabs - **Single Lead** (manual one-by-one entry: First name, Last name, Email, Industry, Company all required) and **Lead Database** (opens the [AI Lead Search](/docs/cold-email-agent/campaigns/managing-campaigns/scrape-leads) scraper). |
| **Import Leads** | Opens the [CSV import flow](/docs/cold-email-agent/campaigns/managing-campaigns/import-leads). |
| **Export Leads** | Downloads leads as a CSV. If individual rows are selected, it exports only those rows. If no rows are selected, or if you used **Select all**, it exports every lead matching the current search, status filter, advanced filters, and sort. |
| **Delete All** | Deletes the current lead set after a confirmation prompt. If search, status filter, or advanced filters are active, it deletes the matching filtered set. If no filters are active, it deletes every lead in the campaign. Permanent. |

New leads added via Add Leads or Import Leads run through duplicate checks so the same person does not receive multiple campaigns at once. The preview-count behavior is only for **AI Lead Search**: in standalone Acquisity, AI Lead Search filters already-owned campaign leads out of future search availability. If Instantly is connected, AI Lead Search preview counts may still include duplicates; those duplicates are blocked only when the platform tries to upload them, and can still consume credits. CSV imports do not have an AI Lead Search preview count; duplicates are checked during upload.

## Export Leads

Exports include lead data, lifecycle status data, and deliverability data where available.

Common export fields include:

- Lead fields such as name, email, company, title, industry, location, LinkedIn, website, and company description.
- **Status**, **allStatuses**, and **statusUpdatedAt**.
- Source and date added.
- Email activity fields, including sent, opens, and bounces.
- Email deliverability fields such as **Email Provider** and **Email Security Gateway** when available from the provider.

### What gets exported

| Current state | What Export Leads downloads |
| --- | --- |
| No filters and no row selection | All campaign leads |
| Status/search/advanced filters active | All leads matching those filters |
| Individual rows selected | Only the selected rows |
| **Select all** used after filtering | All matching leads across every page |

## Bulk delete vs. Delete All

Two paths to remove leads:

| Path | When to use |
|---|---|
| **Tick rows → bulk-action bar → Delete selected** | Removing a specific subset. Combine status/search/filter controls with **Select all** or **Select this page**, then delete the matching leads. |
| **Toolbar → Delete All** | Wiping a lead set clean. If filters are active, it deletes the filtered set. If no filters are active, it deletes the whole campaign's leads. |

For freeing cap room, the right workflow is: **Export Leads** first (to keep the data), then either bulk-delete a filtered subset or use Delete All. The campaign and its analytics stay in place either way - only the lead records go.

## You'll know your leads are healthy when…

- **Email Bounce Rate** is under 2% (target shown on the metric card).
- **Leads Contacted** climbs steadily toward Leads Uploaded as the campaign sends through its sequence.
- **Leads In Progress** drops over time as leads either reply (move to Reply Received / Interested / etc.) or finish the sequence without replying (move to Completed No Reply).
- Variables in your sequence render with real data - open a few leads via **Edit Lead** to spot-check that name, title, company, industry are all populated.

## If something's not right

### Bounce rate is climbing

Don't wait - bounces compound and damage your sender reputation. The rule of thumb:

| Bounce rate | What to do |
|---|---|
| **Under 3%** | Safe. Keep an eye on it but no action needed. |
| **3% to 5%** | Re-verify the lead list (run it through verification on re-import, or use a third-party verification service). Pause the campaign while you do. |
| **Over 5%** | One of two causes: the list has too many unverified addresses, **or** your copy is being flagged as spam. Do **both** - re-verify the list **and** check the sequence for spam-trigger words and risky links. |

The campaign auto-pauses at 5% via [bounce protection](/docs/cold-email-agent/faq/campaigns/where-is-the-bounce-protection-toggle-for-a-paused-campaign).

### My variables show as blank in sent emails

The lead is missing data for that field. Open the lead via the three-dot menu - **Edit Lead** and check whether `title`, `company`, etc. are filled. If they're blank, the variable has nothing to render.

Fix either by editing individual leads, or by re-importing a corrected CSV. See the [blank-variable FAQ](/docs/cold-email-agent/faq/sequences-and-variants/why-does-jobtitle-show-in-preview-but-go-blank-in-the-sent-email).

### Lots of leads got skipped as duplicates

The platform deduplicates **across every campaign in your workspace**. A lead that's in any other campaign here gets flagged on import and skipped, so the same person doesn't get emailed by two campaigns at once.

For **AI Lead Search** in standalone Acquisity, the search usually filters those already-owned leads out before you import. With Instantly connected, the preview can still show duplicates and the upload can skip them later. CSV imports are checked during upload.

To force-add: delete the lead from the other campaign first, then re-import.

### I want to free room under my campaign lead capacity

Growth organizations share one **5,000 concurrent campaign-lead limit** across all configured campaign provider workspaces. Other plans use provider-specific workspace capacity, which is often 25,000 but can vary by provider and plan.

1. Open an old campaign whose leads you no longer need active.
2. Click **Export Leads** to keep the data.
3. Either tick/select the leads and **Delete selected**, or hit **Delete All** to wipe the matching set in one go.
4. Leave the campaign itself in place - its analytics stay intact and you can see what the campaign actually achieved.

Capacity returns after Acquisity reconciles the deletion with the campaign provider. See [the campaign lead capacity guide](/docs/workspace-settings/faq/billing-subscriptions/is-there-a-limit-on-how-many-leads-i-can-upload-or-store) for the canonical plan rules and what counts against capacity.

### How do I see which leads I haven't emailed yet?

Use **Status → Not Yet Contacted**, and the table narrows to just those rows. Click **Export Leads** with that filter on if you want a file of just the un-contacted leads.

### Pagination - finding leads further down the list

The table paginates at 50 rows per page by default. Change the count via the **rows per page** dropdown at the bottom-left, or use the page-navigation arrows on the bottom-right to step through. Big lists can run to 80+ pages - use **Search** or **Filter** rather than paging through manually.

## Related

- [Lead lifecycle](/docs/cold-email-agent/concepts/lead-lifecycle) - every status and what triggers each transition
- [Importing leads via CSV](/docs/cold-email-agent/campaigns/managing-campaigns/import-leads) - what the **Import Leads** button opens
- [AI Lead Search](/docs/cold-email-agent/campaigns/managing-campaigns/scrape-leads) - what **Add Leads → Lead Database** opens
- [Personalization](/docs/cold-email-agent/concepts/personalization) - why variable data on each lead matters
- [Lead search FAQ](/docs/cold-email-agent/faq/lead-search) - common questions on imports, exports, and lead management
